Shah Rukh Khan named India's most valuable celebrity brand

Shah Rukh Khan has been ranked as India's most valuable celebrity brand, surpassing Virat Kohli. According to reports, Khan's brand value stands at ₹1694 crore. Ranveer Singh secured the second position, followed by other prominent figures like Amitabh Bachchan and Akshay Kumar in the top 10. Alia Bhatt was also highlighted as the 'Brand Queen' with a value of ₹892 crore, outranking Ranbir Kapoor, Deepika Padukone, and Rashmika Mandanna.
